title: Lost in Aggregation: The Causal Interpretation of the Instrumental Variable Estimand
abstract: arXiv:2601.12120v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Instrumental variable estimation has emerged as a standard approach to mitigating confounding bias in the social sciences and epidemiology, where conducting randomized experiments can be too costly or infeasible. However, justifying the validity of the instrument is frequently challenging. We highlight a problem generally neglected in arguments for instrumental variable validity: the presence of an "aggregate treatment variable", where the treatment (e.g., education, GDP, caloric intake) is composed of finer-grained, unobserved components that each may have a different effect on the outcome. While the aggregation problem itself is general, our focus is on instrumental variable estimation in a linear setting, the regime underlying much of applied instrumental variable practice. We show that the causal effect of an aggregate treatment is generally ambiguous, as it depends on how an intervention on the aggregate is instantiated at

translated_title: 迷失于聚合中：工具变量估计对象的因果解释
translated_abstract: 工具变量估计已成为社会科学和流行病学中减轻混杂偏差的标准方法，因为在这些领域开展随机实验的成本可能过于高昂或不可行。然而，证明工具变量的有效性往往具有挑战性。我们强调了在论证工具变量有效性时普遍被忽视的一个问题：“聚合处理变量”的存在，即处理变量（如教育、GDP、热量摄入）由更细粒度的、未被观测的成分组成，而每种成分可能对结果产生不同的影响。虽然聚合问题本身具有普遍性，但我们的重点放在线性设定下的工具变量估计上，这是大多数应用工具变量实践的基础。我们证明，聚合处理的因果效应通常是模糊的，因为它取决于对聚合变量的干预是如何被具体实施的。
tldr: 本文揭示了一个在工具变量有效性论证中被普遍忽视的“聚合处理变量”问题，并证明在线性设定下聚合处理的因果效应通常是模糊的，因为它依赖于对聚合变量干预的具体实施方式。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a neglected "aggregate treatment variable" problem in instrumental variable validity arguments, showing that in linear settings the causal effect of an aggregate treatment is generally ambiguous, as it depends on how an intervention on the aggregate is instantiated.
